newsitem.title: USA: IBM depresses Dow at midday.
newsitem.headline: IBM depresses Dow at midday.

text.p: An earnings-driven sell-off in shares of International Business Machines Corp kept the Dow Industrials pinned lower at midday.
Elsewhere, however, many high techs continued the move higher, encouraged by the overall good earnings in the sector this quarter.

The Industrials were near their lows for the day, down 65 points, or 0.95 percent, at 6818, after having gone as low as 6808 after IBM opened for trading. IBM was down 10-1/2 at 158-7/8, accounting for about half of the Dow's drop.
